source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 356 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 356 was established by Ordinance No. 21013, passed by the Dallas City Council on August 14, 1991. Ordinance No. 21013 amended Ordinance No. 19455, Chapter 51A of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 19455; 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 356 is established on property generally located at the northwest corner of Dallas Parkway and Gibbons Drive. The size of PD 356 is approximately 11.094 acres. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. (Ord. 25850)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.104. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

Use of the Property must comply with the development plan (Exhibit 356A). (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.105. USES.

The only uses permitted on the Property are those allowed in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Development Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.106. DEVELOPMENT STANDARDS.

Except as otherwise provided in these regulations and standards, development of the Property must comply with the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Maximum Number Of Lots Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.107. MAXIMUM NUMBER OF LOTS PERMITTED.

The Property may be divided into no more than 32 lots. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.108. SETBACKS.

(a) Structures located on lots within this PD must comply with the following minimum setbacks:

(1) Front yard: 20 feet.

(2) Side yard: five feet.

(3) Rear yard: five feet.

(b) Structures located on lots adjacent to Gibbons Drive must maintain a minimum 10 foot setback from Gibbons Drive.

(c) Structures located on lots adjacent to Halls Branch Creek must comply with the provisions contained in Section 51A-5.106, “Setback from Natural Channel Required.” (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Screening Wall
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.109. SCREENING WALL.

A six-foot-high solid masonry screening wall must be constructed within the required 10 foot setback along the easterly and northerly right-of-way line of Gibbons Drive. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Access To Gibbons Drive
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.110. ACCESS TO GIBBONS DRIVE.

No direct access to Gibbons Drive from any lot contiguous to the easterly or northerly lines of Gibbons Drive is permitted. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Sound Abatement Wall
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.111. SOUND ABATEMENT WALL.

An eight-foot-high solid masonry sound abatement wall must be constructed along the east property line adjacent to the west line of Dallas Parkway between the north line of Gibbons Drive and the south line of the floodway management area of Halls Branch Creek. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.112. SIGNS.

All signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII, “Sign Regulations.” (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.113. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Use of the Property must comply with all applicable federal and state laws and regulations, and with all applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.114. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-356.116. ZONING MAP.

PD 356 is located on Zoning Map Nos. AA-6 and A-6. (Ord. Nos. 21013; 25850)
